# Test fixtures

## standing_person.jpg

One young man standing on a road, facing the camera, whole body in frame. Used by
`tests/test_detector.py` to check the real MediaPipe detector (exactly one person, plausible
keypoints).

- Source: Wikimedia Commons, "Young man at Palm Beach (Unsplash).jpg"
  https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Young_man_at_Palm_Beach_(Unsplash).jpg
  (originally https://unsplash.com/photos/OSRb7gfZlxo)
- Author: Mohammad Faruque (https://unsplash.com/@primitivestudios)
- Licence: CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain dedication),
  https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ — no attribution required; credited anyway.
- Changes: the original 3312×4286 photo was cropped to the bottom 3312×3312 square (keeps the
  whole body) and resized to 960×960, JPEG quality 85.
